Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Slaughterhouse says "Tap to burn up to 2 cards from the top of
your prey's library." To use this ability, do you tap it and
say to your prey one of "burn two cards from the top of your
library", "burn one card from the top of your library", or "burn
no cards from the top of your library"?

Or does the "up to" only mean that it still works if there is
only one card (or no cards) in your prey's library to be burned?

Thanks,

Josh

slaughtering the house
